description: Headspaceスタイル — 既存キャラクターと同じフラットデザインに統一

left.label: Not Me（左スワイプ）
left.prompt:
Headspace-style flat design character icon on transparent background.

A small round GRAY character with a SAD/UNCERTAIN expression.
- Body: simple solid GRAY circle. COMPLETELY FLAT — ONE single gray color (#9CA3AF), ZERO shading, ZERO shadow, ZERO highlights, ZERO color variation anywhere on the body. Just one flat gray circle.
- Eyes: TWO WHITE CIRCLES with BLACK DOTS inside (white sclera + black pupils)
- Mouth: small simple frown
- ALL FOUR LIMBS must be IDENTICAL THICKNESS: each arm and each leg is a short fat rounded sausage/cylinder shape. The pointing arm MUST be the same thickness as the legs. No thin arms.
- Left arm points LEFT — same fat sausage thickness as the legs
- Right arm hangs at side — same fat sausage thickness
- Speech bubble above: WARM LIGHT GRAY background (#E8E5E0), rounded rectangle, bold black text "Not Me"

ABSOLUTELY NO shadows, NO shading, NO gradients, NO highlights, NO color variations on the body. Every pixel of the body is the exact same gray. Flat vector, bold solid colors, simple geometric shapes. Transparent background.

Flat vector style, bold colors, simple geometric shapes, NO gradients, NO shadows, NO glossy shine, NO realistic textures.
